title: Phantastes: A Faerie Romance for Men and Women
sourceTitle: Phantastes: A Faerie Romance for Men and Women
author: George MacDonald
description: "Phantastes: A Faerie Romance for Men and Women" by George MacDonald is a fantasy novel published in 1858.
longDescription: When young Anodos discovers a fairy in his inherited desk, his bedroom transforms into an enchanted forest. He enters a dreamlike Fairy Land where he pursues an elusive Marble Lady through forests, palaces, and subterranean worlds.

authorInfo.bio: George MacDonald was a Scottish author, poet and Congregational minister. He became a pioneering figure in the field of modern fantasy literature and the mentor of fellow-writer Lewis Carroll. In addition to his fairy tales, MacDonald wrote several works of Christian theology, including several collections of sermons.
